results.title: Pops
results.overview: Through the eyes of an aspiring documentary film maker called Nathan, fostered siblings are reunited and go on a journey together to uncover the past, people and gain closure on the mysteries of the home they were raised in.

results.title: Misophonia
results.overview: When Martin is fired and subsequently forced to move in with his sister following a Misophonia outburst at work, he sets out on a comically disgruntled mission to identify ways he might manage his Misophonia and get his life back on track.

results.title: Monero
results.overview: A story based on true events and dedicated to the Mexican cartoonist RIUS.  In 1968 Mexico City, Mancha—a cartoonist for the magazine "La Garrapata"—battles government censorship of his work under Gustavo Díaz Ordaz, while one of his own cartoon characters manifests in the real world, urging him to be brave and fight for what he believes in.

results.title: Cùil Lodair
results.overview: Set in the aftermath of the infamous Battle of Culloden, Cùil Lodair follows Eòin, a defeated Highland soldier navigating a shattered landscape.

results.title: Forgotten Heritage of Arab Medicine
results.original_title: Les trésors oubliés de la médecine arabe
results.overview: More than a thousand years ago, a brilliant civilization unified by the Arabic language stretched from Spain to the banks of the Indus River. Between the 8th and 13th centuries, as it expanded its territory, its scholars gathered and translated medical knowledge from antiquity, enriching it with their own discoveries. During this period, Geber, Al-Kindi, Al-Razi, Avicenna, and Averroes observed, experimented, and compared to develop thousands of remedies, laying the foundations of modern pharmacology.

results.title: Love Is the Monster
results.overview: In a dystopian world marked by inequality and everyday violence, a grandmother is determined to make the most of the time she has left with her granddaughter. But as a series of events pushes them into increasing danger, love and fear begin to blur, forcing her to cross lines she never imagined.

results.title: The Withering
results.overview: After an elderly woman discovers a mysterious amulet that restores her youth by draining the life from those around her, her caregiver must stop her as an entire town withers in a grotesque battle over renewal and the terror of aging.

results.title: To Love
results.overview: A mother cares for an old woman with dementia through the ritual of washing laundry.

results.title: Greta e le favole vere
results.overview: Nine-year-old Greta loves making Christmas decorations with her babysitter, Katy. She believes so strongly in Santa Claus that she decides to deliver a letter to her neighbor, Nicola, who leads her to believe he is Santa's personal assistant. Of course, Nicola has been lying; when Greta exposes the truth, he confesses that he has no connection to Santa Claus. To make amends, Nicola—a talented illustrator—draws an animated fairy tale for her that will change her life.

results.title: Where is Mr Right
results.overview: Successful event planner Bunmi longs for love and a family. results.overview: A brand-new little book gets lost in the vast maze of a grand library and journeys through every section in search of where he belongs, only to realize that the most meaningful place to be isn't always where you fit in best.
